_about: Hand-checked parish facts that change how the schedule is read. no_weekday_mass_on_ph: parish ids with no weekday (Monday-Friday) Mass on public holidays. add_rules: weekly Mass rules myCatholicSG lacks or mislabels, by parish id, same shape as data/mycatholic.json rules (weeks 1..5, -1 = last); a myCatholicSG dated entry at the same date, time and place merges into it.
